title: dod-as-prompt
description: The typed envelope carrying a MEASURABLE Definition-of-Done for a recovered goal. A thin wrapper over the Prisma engine (decompose-abstract-to-measurable): it holds the Prisma `measurement_spec` (the DoD as a value-tree of D/T/J leaves), the eko L5 acceptance/KPI projection of those leaves, and — once evaluated — the Prisma score/band. Its `termination_predicate` string is what gap-loop/quiesce consume via `--condition`. NO new measurement engine: authoring the value-tree and scoring it are BOTH Prisma's job (LLM proposes leaves; scripts/structural_route.py form-gates the tree and scripts/aggregate_spec.py rolls it up deterministically). This envelope is the wiring.

for_goal.description: the {{goal}} this DoD measures — MUST equal the driving handoff-as-prompt.params.goal (L8 traceability). A DoD divorced from its goal is a SpecError. Non-empty unless inconclusive.flag=true (DEFER) — enforced by the allOf below and by validate_envelope.py.

confidence.description: PROVENANCE GATE (mirrors handoff-as-prompt.params.confidence). Aggregate confidence [0,1] that this DoD correctly measures for_goal. Below conf_inconclusive (default 0.60) MUST set inconclusive.flag=true. Without this gate a DoD fabricated from nothing validated with exit 0 — the anti-fabrication bar the sibling handoff already carries.

recovered_from.description: PROVENANCE GATE (mirrors handoff-as-prompt.params.recovered_from). The audit trail of which sources were ACTUALLY read to DERIVE this DoD (the recovered goal + the state measured). Ordered strongest-first. An empty array with confidence>0 is a SpecError — a confident DoD must cite where it came from (anti-theater grounding).

read.description: true = this source existed and was read; false = probed-but-absent (still auditable)

inconclusive.description: PROVENANCE/HITL GATE (mirrors handoff-as-prompt.params.inconclusive). flag=true => the DoD DERIVATION is not trustworthy enough to drive a loop autonomously (low confidence / no source anchor / ambiguous goal) => escalate to HITL. Distinct from params.evaluation.inconclusive, which is about SCORING current progress once the DoD exists.

context_lock.description: = Prisma measurement-spec meta.context_lock (Step-0 hard gate — a context-free DoD is refused). Sourced from the handoff-as-prompt: context<-context, purpose<-objectives.originating, stakeholder/targets<-scope+motivations. A construct is only measurable relative to this (Harnad grounding).

measurement_spec.description: THE DoD as a Prisma value-tree. MUST validate against skills/decompose-abstract-to-measurable/templates/measurement-spec.schema.json — full validation is DELEGATED to Prisma's TWO-script pipeline scripts/structural_route.py (fail-closed FORM gate: an additive value-tree validly represents only additive/atomic; relational/gestalt -> blocked; normative/dispositional/temporal -> assistive-capped) THEN scripts/aggregate_spec.py (deterministic roll-up) (DRY: this envelope only asserts the load-bearing keys are present; it does NOT re-encode Prisma's whole schema). meta.construct is the DoD framed as a measurable question (e.g. 'is {{goal}} DONE and healthy?'); nodes[] are the D/T/J leaves (D=deterministic-measurable preferred; J=judgment last-resort with a stated why-not-D/T).

acceptance.description: eko L5 projection — the binary-checkable DoD items, human-readable, one per material D/T leaf. The 'is it done?' checklist.

kpis.description: eko L5 projection — measurable success signals derived from the leaves (e.g. 'tests 100% pass', 'gitleaks clean', 'aggregate score >= 0.85').

termination_predicate.description: THE string gap-loop/quiesce consume as --condition. Derived from the DoD: the loop is DONE when the D/T leaves are satisfied AND Prisma inconclusive.flag=false AND (score >= thresholds.band_high). Deterministic given the measurement_spec.

evaluation.description: OPTIONAL — the Prisma aggregate_spec.py OUTPUT, present once the loop has scored current progress against the DoD. Absent at derivation time (the DoD DEFINITION is stable; the leaf VALUES change as work progresses). inconclusive.flag=true here => the DoD itself cannot be scored (judgment-dominated / low-confidence / branch-conflict) => HITL, same gate as Prisma.

$comment: Idempotency (validate_envelope.py --digest): the DoD DEFINITION (context_lock + measurement_spec structure + termination_predicate + recovered_from provenance) is canonicalized (leaf VALUES/confidence + evaluation stripped) so the same {goal,context} yields the same DoD-shape digest across runs. Exit: 0 valid, 2 unreadable, 3 SpecError. PROVENANCE GATE (mirrors the handoff): params.confidence + params.recovered_from + params.inconclusive are REQUIRED, and recovered_from empty while confidence>0 is refused — closing the hole where a DoD fabricated from nothing validated with exit 0. SpecError cases: absent required key; empty for_goal without inconclusive.flag=true; recovered_from empty while confidence>0; confidence<conf_inconclusive while inconclusive.flag=false; measurement_spec missing meta.context_lock (Prisma Step-0). Deep leaf/anchor validation + the authoritative D/T/J + inconclusive verdict are delegated to Prisma's two scripts, run in order: skills/decompose-abstract-to-measurable/scripts/structural_route.py (fail-closed form-gate — additive_unverified/relational/gestalt caps the score to assistive-only + human_review) THEN skills/decompose-abstract-to-measurable/scripts/aggregate_spec.py (roll-up). ooda-loop's ACT gate consults BOTH: a capped structural status is treated as inconclusive -> HITL.
